description_en: Queries the WebSocket network bandwidth monitoring data for a domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData查询域名WebSocket协议的网络带宽监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-websocket-bps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name.

Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). By default, all accelerated domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名。

多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔，默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the data to retrieve.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to retrieve.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data to query, in seconds.

Based on the maximum time span of a single query, this parameter supports the values 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see the supported time granularities in Usage notes
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位为秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the ISP.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to query ISPs. By default, all ISPs are queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to query regions. By default, all regions are queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en
